units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 3:3:3">Y. R. Hash. III, 58ᵈ</cite> top <he>היה … מחמת הצ׳</he> if its sound became thick on account of the overlaying (of the mouthpiece with gold).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 3:8:5">Y. Ḥag. III, end, 79ᵈ</cite> <he>לא צ׳ שעומד וכ׳</he> was the overlaying (of the altar) not solid enough to stand by itself? <cite ref="Temurah 28b:11">Tem. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>יהא צִיפּוּיוֹ מותר</he> let the metal used for overlaying it (its horns &c.) be permitted; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צִיפּוּיִים</he>, <he>צִיפּוּיִין</he>, <cite ref="R00409"><he>צִפּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Temurah 28b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>צִיפּוּיָין</he>, <he>צִיפּוּיֵיהֶן</he>; Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. II, Par. 2 <he>צִפּוּיָיו</he>, <he>צִפּוּיָו</he>; a. e.
